abstract: Manages science drilling permits and laboratory fuel allocation registers
system_message:
You are the Glaciological scientific operations coordinator (GLAC). Your responsibilities include overseeing scientific drilling authorizations, tracking auxiliary science laboratory fuel demands, and monitoring subglacial acoustic profiling across candidate polar research locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages science drilling permits and laboratory fuel allocation registers（DRILL）
information_points.content:
GLAC-DRILL-8EY：For Wilkes Coast Nunatak, deep ice-core drilling authorization is not granted for the proposed bedrock-depth core extraction borehole, and the auxiliary science lab fuel demand for mobile modules and core storage refrigeration over winter is 25 kL.
GLAC-DRILL-686：For Cape Adare Coastal Bluff, deep ice-core drilling authorization is granted for the proposed bedrock-depth core extraction borehole, and the auxiliary science lab fuel demand for mobile modules and core storage refrigeration over winter is 25 kL.
GLAC-DRILL-5TV：For Terra Nova Bay Ridge, deep ice-core drilling authorization is granted for the proposed bedrock-depth core extraction borehole, and the auxiliary science lab fuel demand for mobile modules and core storage refrigeration over winter is 20 kL.

information_points.title: Subglacial acoustic profiling（SEISMIC）
information_points.content:
GLAC-SEISMIC-LY8：At Wilkes Coast Nunatak, subglacial acoustic profiling records an acoustic sensor array density of 8 geophones along the one-kilometer sampling transect.
GLAC-SEISMIC-MDU：At Cape Adare Coastal Bluff, subglacial acoustic profiling records an acoustic sensor array density of 16 geophones along the one-kilometer sampling transect.
GLAC-SEISMIC-Z3L：At Terra Nova Bay Ridge, subglacial acoustic profiling records an acoustic sensor array density of 12 geophones along the one-kilometer sampling transect.
